controls.name: Tools Tab
controls.label:
Additional Tools / There are many additional tools available that allow you to expand your understanding of The Bibites or add a few functionalities that are not yet present in-game. Here, I'll try to link you to a few of those. / The Bibites' Wikipedia / The wiki is a treasure trove of information regarding the inner workings of the simulation and will allow you to get a far deeper understanding of the mechanics at play. It's by no means complete; I basically just added the first basic information myself, and I expect the community to take the ball and maintain, deepen, and bolster it. / The Bibite Research Conglomerate / This is a link to the Bibite Research Conglomerate, an un-official Discord server that is centered around exploring The Bibites under all its facets. 
This is 100% a public fan-made and fan-maintained server, and the devs are not there themselves, but we mentioned it in a couple videos and people keep asking for the link

So if you want to interact with an awesome community of moders, researchers, and share your discoveries and creations, I'm sure they'll welcome you with open arms! / The Bibites Patreon Simulation / And again, of course, I want to reiterate my eternal gratitude toward my patrons who are supporting the project on Patreon. You allow me to keep working on the project full-time, and I'll be forever grateful for this reason alone. / The Custom Sprite Editor / As the bibites have procedural appearances, allowing the bibites to adopt a wide variety of appearances depending on their genes, and as I often have to show an image of a particular bibite in my videos, I developed a custom sprite editor that allows you to export an image of a bibite defined by a set of genes. I might as well make it available to users!

the sim and how it works / Submit a Champion to Compete and test their strengths and weaknesses in a few select challenges of our own design!

Select your champion from any of the bibites you saved along the way or try submitting one of your own engineered bibites! 

Try to improve your score, and why not win some acheivements while you're at it!

controls.name: Button
controls.label:
Engineer a Bibite / Not for the faint of heart!
Only for experts / Open the Bibite Editor and create your own bibite from the bottom up!

You'll have to fully design their brain and finetune their genes, otherwise most of your creations won't make it to reproduction

For this reason, patience is recommended, 

So wait until after you understand the basics of the simulation and its different systems before getting started here.

Select from a our official list of tried and tested official scenarios, or create and save your own!  

Then let time do its thing, and watch carefully as the bibites slowly adapt to that scenario


Who knows what behaviors may emerge!

- // Keypad- => zoom out (x1.25)
Home => return to (0,0) / Selection Hotkeys: / R => select random bibite
E => select random egg
G => select bibite with highest gen count
O => select oldest bibite

F5 => save the game under "quick.zip", overwriting any previous quicksave
F9 => load last quick save
Insert => Lay Egg of selected bibite
Delete => Kill selected bibite or egg
